name: Eataly
verdict: 52% owned by the investment group Investindustrial, with the founding Farinetti family among the other shareholders. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to eataly.co.uk, stands under 'Official Partners' with the line 'Italian food retail and catering in the world' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): under the September 2022 agreement Investindustrial VII L.P. holds 52% of Eataly S.p.A., and Eatinvest (Farinetti family), the Baffigo/Miroglio family and Clubitaly (Tamburi Investment Partners) the other 48% (eataly-investindustrial). The investors in Investindustrial's fund aren't published; no source names a state or state fund among Eataly's shareholders. No human-rights finding against the company found.
